_comment: Config for deploy/New-FinancialRecordsRetention.ps1. Author-only reference data - NOT applied to any tenant unless passed to the deploy script without -DryRun. Creates a REGULATORY RECORD retention label for financial records (SEC 17a-4-style WORM immutability) and an auto-apply label policy that stamps it onto content in the finance locations. Read README.md Sections 2 and 11 before deploying - a regulatory record label is IRREVERSIBLE once applied.

label.name: Financial Records - 7yr Regulatory
label.comment: Broker-dealer financial books-and-records retained 7 years, first 2 years accessible, as a non-rewriteable/non-erasable regulatory record (SEC 17a-4(b)/(f)).
label._labelNote: retentionAction: Keep | Delete | KeepAndDelete. retentionDurationDays: integer days (2555 ~= 7 years) or the string 'Unlimited'. retentionType: when the clock starts - CreationAgeInDays | ModificationAgeInDays | TaggedAgeInDays | EventAgeInDays. regulatory=true makes it a REGULATORY RECORD (strongest immutability: cannot be removed, relabeled, unlocked, or its retention shortened; content cannot be edited/deleted) - this option is only creatable in PowerShell, not the portal by default (README.md Section 5). isRecordLabel is implied by regulatory but kept explicit.

policy.name: Auto-apply Financial Records - Finance sites
policy.comment: Auto-applies the Financial Records regulatory label to finance content.
policy._policyNote: At least one location is required. Use adaptive scopes for large/dynamic estates (out of scope here - see README.md Section 11). Static-scope SharePoint site URL(s) shown.

rule.contentMatchQuery: SensitiveType:"Credit Card Number" OR "invoice" OR "general ledger" OR "trial balance"
rule._ruleNote: KQL for auto-apply matching (-ContentMatchQuery). Narrow this to your real financial-record signals - an over-broad query stamps an IRREVERSIBLE regulatory label onto non-records. Alternatively match sensitive information types via a -ContentContainsSensitiveInformation hashtable (not shown; see New-RetentionComplianceRule reference). Auto-apply can take up to 7 days to take effect.
